verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is primarily a terminal/TUI-based coding agent, but evidence indicates VS Code, Cursor, and JetBrains connectors are live, implying in-IDE chat access; however, there is no detailed documentation of the in-IDE chat UX, context-sharing behavior, or independent confirmation of how the connectors function. missing for 10: detailed IDE-integration docs describing chat UI/UX inside the editor, independent/hands-on verification of the connectors working, and confirmation that context (open files, cursor position) is passed to the assistant.
